title: 知识图谱中的可扩展不确定性推理
summary: 该论文提出一个模块化框架，针对知识图谱中三种不确定性（属性值不精确、三元组存在概率性、模式知识不完整）分别采用代数、逻辑和几何方法进行推理，旨在兼顾语义精度与计算可处理性。
summary_en: This thesis proposes a modular framework for reasoning over three levels of uncertainty in knowledge graphs (imprecise attributes, probabilistic triples, incomplete schema) using algebraic, logical, and geometric approaches to balance semantic precision and computational tractability.
